subject: Q3 QBR prep — OKR triage + board deck appendix routing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Jane Singh <jane.singh@tiltvp.com>, BoardOps <boardops@tiltvp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 QBR prep — OKR triage + board deck appendix routing

Team —

Attached is the current QBR deck (v0.9) and the OKR tracker export. High-level asks: 1) which OKR flags should we call out in the one-pager (we want to be candid but not granular), 2) what goes into the board appendix (metrics we surface vs. backup), and 3) can we agree on a final freeze time — aiming for Thursday 12:00pm PT so Legal has time for sign-off.

Notes/context: Tilt asked for a short appendix with ARR movement, top-5 customer escalations, and a short note on reliability incidents and mitigations since last QBR. I added an appendix slide stub (last three slides).

Please reply with: a) recommended OKR flags (one-liners), b) items you want moved to appendix, and c) any slide-level edits you insist on before freeze. If you can, mark changes directly in the Drive link and comment in the deck by EOD.

Attachments: Q3_QBR_deck_v0.9.pptx (deck draft), OKR_tracker_Q3.xlsx (export), appendix_metrics_v2.pdf (candidate metrics)

Thanks —
Marcus
Head of Product Strategy | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodai.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Jane Singh <jane.singh@tiltvp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep — OKR triage + board deck appendix routing

Thanks Marcus — quick thoughts: 

- OKR flags to surface (one-liners):
  * "Latency SLO: sustained 12% improvement quarter-over-quarter — continuing optimization cycle."
  * "Cost per inference down 9% vs. Q2; still above target for low-utilization workloads."
  * "Dedicated contracts: two new commitments in legal review; renewals proceeding as expected."

- Appendix items: ARR movement table (slide A1), incident timeline + RCA (A2), Top-5 customer asks + outcomes (A3). Put deep metric tables in backup only.

- Slide-level edits: put the ARR waterfall earlier (replace current slide 6) and add a 2-line context blurb on quantization gains on the technical appendix.

I made inline comments on the deck and flagged slide 3 where the narrative needs a clearer lead. If Legal needs more runway, push freeze to Thursday 4pm PT, otherwise I can approve by noon.

-Neha
VP, Operations

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>

Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep — OKR triage + board deck appendix routing

Fwding a short editorial pass and a couple of micro-asks — see below.

My edits (applied in the deck as comments and small text changes):
- Tightened the executive summary to 3 bullets (value, momentum, risk).
- Reworded slide 4 headline to avoid overly technical jargon for board audience.
- Suggested replacing a full chart with a headline stat + link to appendix on slide 7 to keep flow.

Mina — quick ask for you: can you generate a single-slide customer escalation summary (A3) with 3 bullets per customer and current status by 5pm today?

I can take point on slide freeze coordination once we confirm Legal window. If Legal wants more time, we can still hit the board readout but will shift the pre-reads delivery schedule.

—Tessa
Head of Communications

From: Jane Singh <jane.singh@tiltvp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR prep — OKR triage + board deck appendix routing

Marcus / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few notes from the boardops side:

- Appendix A2 (incident timeline + RCA) is important to include; keep it concise but please include the mitigation plan and dates.
- We prefer the ARR waterfall and topline movement earlier in the deck; good catch from Neha.
- Pre-reads: can you deliver the finalized PDF by Friday 9:00am PT so the board has weekend access? If Legal needs extra time, please flag ASAP and we can move the board pre-read window.

Happy to join a 20-minute sync this afternoon if you want to run through the tight edits — otherwise this flow works.

Thanks,
Jane Singh
Board Liaison | Tilt Venture Partners
janes@tiltvp.com
